sourceScopes: ui-failure-attachments (recursive proof files; compiler module-cache excluded)
explicitlyExcluded: Active board-ui-clean-modal-setup, DerivedData/apps, unarchived current active results, tmp fixtures, canonical packages, queues, and historical records.
preservationMethod: Exact byte copy or exact SHA-256 identity reuse; source/retained paths identify every requested proof even when repeated images or empty logs share one stored copy.
statuses: Original recorded statuses are preserved in their unchanged raw files; packaging does not reinterpret or upgrade them.

accounting.scope: Preparation only. Recorded run statuses, interrupted collector results, failures, and additive corrections remain unchanged; no new test/build/runtime PASS, PR, human acceptance, or cleanup claim.
